name: ps-read-manifest-key-limits
body: read_manifest keeps the first of a repeated key (e.g. 'RootModule' then rootmodule), where PowerShell rejects such a manifest, and reads only the hashtable's direct hash_entry children, so an entry the grammar folds into an ERROR node is skipped — a broken entry can pull the valid entry before it into that ERROR and silently drop its key. Limit: duplicate-key and broken-manifest handling follow the grammar, not PowerShell's own refusal. Upgrade by reporting duplicate keys and dropped entries as diagnostics when manifest errors need surfacing.
